## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D1 (c, shell and page components). No audit backlog id. Created from the audit's rulings and blueprint, not from a backlog line (see Findings).

Persona and route: Components only, in /__ui. Later every page in every role.
Findings and reviewers: F-19, F-17 (denied state), F-11 (two-pane layout) · reviewers B-09, B-22, C-04. From the blueprint's Next list; no UX number of its own in the backlog.
Rationale: 97 inline card strings, 10 local Message functions, 20 hand-built view switches in five styles and four hand-built two-pane grids. The screen tickets of wave D2 need these pieces: the refused screen needs PageMessage, the consultation needs SplitLayout and Sheet, the board needs SegmentedControl.
Proposed UX behaviour: Card and Section: two sizes only, page section (16 px padding, 12 px radius) and list item (12 px padding, 10 px radius), with title, intro and actions slots; no bordered card directly inside a bordered card. PageMessage and EmptyState: one component for busy, error, empty and denied, with an icon, a sentence, and one next action. SegmentedControl: one view switch (grey track, white selected segment, 44 px, optional icon), with the pressed state exposed to assistive technology. SplitLayout: a main and a side pane (side 320 px, or 360 px for the consultation chart panel) at 1024 px and wider; under 1024 the side becomes a Sheet (a drawer with a focus trap, Escape to close, focus returned to the opener, mirrored in right-to-left; translate 200 ms, opacity only under reduced motion).
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/08-design-system-blueprint.md sections 7, 8 and 12; docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/screenshots/doctor-768-chart-open.png for the drawer.
Components and tokens affected: New card.tsx, page-message.tsx, segmented-control.tsx, split-layout.tsx, sheet.tsx in packages/ui. Uses width, radius and motion tokens.
Front end and back end split: Front end only.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the D1a tickets for control defaults and type tokens. File ownership in wave D1c: its five files. The three D1c tickets each add their own gallery section file and one export line in packages/ui/src/index.ts; a conflict there is one line.
Clinical sign-off: Not required.
Effort and regression risk: M · Low: nothing uses them yet.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Replacing the inline cards, local Message functions and view switches in features (the after-pilot adoption tickets, except where a wave D2 ticket already touches the file). (2) Skeletons (the status and motion ticket).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given /__ui, when PageMessage is opened, then busy, error, empty and denied each show an icon, a sentence and at most one action, in English and Arabic
- [ ] **AC2.** Given SegmentedControl with three options, when it is used by keyboard, then arrow keys or Tab move between options, the selected one is exposed as pressed, and each segment is at least 44 px tall
- [ ] **AC3.** Given Card, when its props are read, then only the page-section and list-item sizes exist and nesting a bordered card in a bordered card is flagged in development
- [ ] **AC4.** Given SplitLayout at 1024 px and at 768 px, when the side content is opened, then at 1024 it is beside the main pane and at 768 it is a Sheet that traps focus, closes on Escape and returns focus to the opener
- [ ] **AC5.** Given reduced motion, when the Sheet opens, then it appears with opacity only and no movement
- [ ] **AC6.** Given the gallery in English and Arabic, when axe runs with the Sheet open and closed, then there is no violation and the Sheet opens from the correct side in right-to-left

## Test notes

- Vitest per component.
- Playwright on /__ui: keyboard path for SegmentedControl and Sheet; 1024 and 768; en and ar; axe.

## Notes / open questions

- Regression risk: low.
